lines.en: label yumidorm30:
I knock on Yumi’s door and wait for-
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的门，等着——

lines.en: : Go the fuck away! I’m busy.
lines.zh: : 给老子滚！我忙着呢。

lines.en: I knock on Yumi’s door and she immediately answers.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Yumi 的门，她立刻应了声。

lines.en: : Busy doing what?
lines.zh: : 忙什么呢？

lines.en: : Are all of your clothes on?
lines.zh: : 你衣服都穿好了吗？

lines.en: : Of fucking course they are! But that shouldn't make a-
lines.zh: : 当然他妈穿好了！但这不代表你就——

lines.en: scene black
: Cool. Then that means I can come in.
lines.zh: : 那挺好。那意思就是我可以进来了。

lines.en: : What the fuck do you think you’re doing?! I just said no!
lines.zh: : 你他妈以为自己在干什么？！我刚说了不行！

lines.en: I open Yumi’s door and make my way into the room, which she definitely wanted me to do.
lines.zh: 我推开 Yumi 的门走进房间——她当然是满心希望我这么做的。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook1
: Get out!
lines.zh: : 滚出去！

lines.en: : Are you...studying?
lines.zh: : 你在……学习？

lines.en: : If I knew it was something this boring, I really would have left you alone.
lines.zh: : 早知道是这么无聊的事，我就真不打扰你了。

lines.en: : Cool! Bye!
lines.zh: : 很好！再见！

lines.en: : So what are you studying?
lines.zh: : 那你在学什么？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook2
: A bunch of different shit Chika told me about since she knows I’m trying to get a job.
lines.zh: : 一堆乱七八糟的东西，Chika 知道我在找工作，就跟我说了这些。

lines.en: : Also, what happened to this being too boring to stick around for?
lines.zh: : 还有，你不是说无聊到待不下去吗？怎么还赖着？

lines.en: : You know where the door is, right? Sure had no trouble finding it on the way in.
lines.zh: : 你知道门在哪儿吧？进来的时候不是找得挺顺手的吗。

lines.en: : If it’s something unrelated to actual education, I’m totally fine with helping you study.
lines.zh: : 只要跟正经学业无关的东西，我都很乐意陪你复习。

lines.en: : What did Chika tell you?
lines.zh: : Chika 跟你说了什么？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook3
: You should probably at least {i}try{/i} to sound like a good teacher every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 你好歹也偶尔{i}装{/i}得像个好老师吧。

lines.en: : Saying you’ll help me study with everything except[school] is like...
lines.zh: : 说什么除了[school]以外什么都能帮我复习，这就好比……

lines.en: : I don’t even know what it’s like. But it’s stupid.
lines.zh: : 我都说不上来像什么。但就是很蠢。

lines.en: : Now fuck off.
lines.zh: : 现在给我滚。

lines.en: : Can I see the notebook?
lines.zh: : 能让我看看笔记本吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook1
: No! You can’t see the fucking notebook!
lines.zh: : 不行！你不能看那本该死的笔记本！

lines.en: : Why not? You’re not secretly writing me another love note, are you?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？你不会是又在偷偷给我写情书吧？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook4
: Love note?! I never wrote you a fucking love note!
lines.zh: : 情书？！我他妈什么时候给你写过情书！

lines.en: : All I said was that you aren’t the worst thing ever!
lines.zh: : 我只是说你还不算世上最烂的东西！

lines.en: : Which was a total lie by the way, as I’m pretty sure you can tell right now!
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句那全是谎话，我想你现在应该看得出来！

lines.en: : You know if you keep yelling, someone is going to find out I’m in here, right?
lines.zh: : 你再这么嚷下去，别人会发现我在你屋里，知道吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook5
: Shouldn’t {i}you{/i} be more worried about that than me? The fuck do I have to lose if someone finds out about this?
lines.zh: : 这事不该是{i}你{/i}比我更该担心吗？被人发现了，我他妈有什么好损失的？

lines.en: : Chances are they probably heard me screaming at you to not come in anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正他们八成已经听见我冲你喊别进来了。

lines.en: : Can I sit down?
lines.zh: : 我能坐下吗？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook6
: Sure, Sensei. I’d love that. In fact, why don’t you walk outside and take a seat on the curb? I’ll be down to meet you in just a few moments.
lines.zh: : 当然，老师。求之不得。要不你干脆出去，到马路牙子上坐会儿？我一会儿就下去找你。

lines.en: : I meant on the bed.
lines.zh: : 我是说坐在床上。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook7
: The second you sit on my bed is the second I decide to throw myself into a volcano.
lines.zh: : 你坐上我床的那一秒，就是我决定跳火山的那一秒。

lines.en: : Bad idea. I can’t imagine there are many job openings inside of volcanoes.
lines.zh: : 这主意不怎么样。我想火山里头应该没多少招聘岗位。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook8
: Can you get out of my room now? Your jokes fucking blow and you’re distracting me from doing something that {i}you{/i} suggested I do in the first place.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}现在能出去吗？你的笑话烂透了，而且最初可是你自己让我做这事，现在反倒来碍我的事。

lines.en: : Let me help, for real this time.
lines.zh: : 让我帮忙吧，这次是认真的。

lines.en: : What sort of stuff did Chika tell you?
lines.zh: : Chika 跟你说了些什么？

lines.en: : A bunch of shit that you never did. Like how important it is to smile and what an iDeCo is.
lines.zh: : 一堆你从来没做过的破事。比如微笑有多重要，还有 iDeCo 是什么。

lines.en: : I...don’t think you need to be worrying about iDeCo’s for a part time job.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得你找兼职用不着操心 iDeCo 这东西。

lines.en: : Maybe I don’t. But who do you think I should believe: some deadbeat who spends his entire work day staring at boobs or some girl who’s working her ass off to support her sister?
lines.zh: : 也许用不着。但你觉得我该信谁：一个是整天上班盯着胸部看的废物，另一个是拼死拼活打工养妹妹的姑娘？

lines.en: Damnit, Chika. Why do you have to be so good?
lines.zh: 该死，Chika。你干嘛非得这么优秀？

lines.en: You’re making me look bad.
lines.zh: 你把衬得我很不堪。

lines.en: I mean, technically {i}I’m{/i} making me look bad.
lines.zh: 我是说，严格来讲是{i}我{/i}自己把自己弄得很不堪。

lines.en: But you’re not helping at all.
lines.zh: 可你一点忙都没帮上。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Whatever. I’m sure that even bringing up some term like “iDeCo” will make you look good in an interview, so we won’t cross it off for now.
lines.zh: : 行行行，随你。我相信面试时哪怕只是提一嘴「iDeCo」这种词也能给你加分，所以暂时先不划掉。

lines.en: : I’m more worried about the fuckin’ smiling part. I have no idea how to do that.
lines.zh: : 我更愁的是他妈微笑那部分。我根本不知道该怎么笑。

lines.en: : You just smiled at me like a minute ago when you told me to go sit on the curb.
lines.zh: : 你一分钟前叫我出去坐马路牙子的时候，不是刚对我笑过吗。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook9
: I did?!
lines.zh: : 我有吗？！

lines.en: : Yes. I remember distinctly because it hurt me.
lines.zh: : 有。我记得特别清楚，因为它伤到我了。

lines.en: : Maybe that’s the trick then? Maybe I just need to think of you every time I want to smile?
lines.zh: : 那也许这就是诀窍？也许我只要每次想笑的时候想想你就行了？

lines.en: : I know that you meant that in an insulting way, but it sounded very cute and I am no longer hurt.
lines.zh: : 我知道你是在骂我，但听起来挺可爱的，所以我不受伤了。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook10
: Ew! Gross! Please don’t even joke about that meaning what...you thought it sounded like. Or something.
lines.zh: : 呕！恶心！别拿这个开玩笑，说得像……像你以为的那个意思似的。还是什么的。

lines.en: : Fuck you.
lines.zh: : 去你的。

lines.en: : That aside, what else do you have in there?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你那本子里还记了什么？

lines.en: : Did Chika give you any ideas on more places to apply?
lines.zh: : Chika 有没有给你推荐更多可以投的地方？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook11
: Well...she suggested a few places from the mall. But I’ve been caught stealing there before and I don’t know if I’m allowed back.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她提了商场里几家店。但我以前在那儿偷东西被抓过，不知道还让不让我进去。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine they keep track of everyone who’s stolen from them before. That sounds like way too much work.
lines.zh: : 我想他们不至于把每个偷过东西的人都记下来吧。那工作量也太大了。

lines.en: : Probably not, but like three of the places she said I should apply to have caught me. And I don’t want word gettin’ around and shit.
lines.zh: : 大概不至于，但她说的那几家里有三家都抓过我。而且我不想让这事传出去什么的。

lines.en: : Just how many times have you stolen things from the mall?
lines.zh: : 你到底在商场偷过多少次东西？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook12
: Uhh...I don’t know. A lot?
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道。很多次？

lines.en: : I’m a fucking [teenage]girl. Even if I wasn’t a delinquent, I’d be stealing shit from the mall. Literally everyone does it.
lines.zh: : 我可是个[teenage]少女。就算我不是不良少女，我也会去商场偷东西。真的每个人都干过。

lines.en: : Well then there you go. It’s not a big deal after all.
lines.zh: : 那不就得了。根本不是什么大事。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook13
: Oh shit. Maybe you’re right?
lines.zh: : 我操。也许你说得对？

lines.en: : And like, there are a lot of fucking stores at the mall. There has to be at least one there that would take me. Right?
lines.zh: : 而且商场里店多得要命。总该有一家肯要我吧？对吧？

lines.en: : I’ve just gotta walk in, smile, namedrop the iDeCo and I’m in.
lines.zh: : 我只要走进去，笑一笑，随口抛出 iDeCo，就稳了。

lines.en: : I’m still not sold on the iDeCo thing, but yeah. We can try that.
lines.zh: : 我还是不太认同 iDeCo 那套，不过行吧。可以试试。

lines.en: : We? You’re coming with me again?
lines.zh: : 我们？你又要跟我一起去？

lines.en: : Of course. I basically consider myself your manager at this point.
lines.zh: : 当然。事到如今我基本把自己当你的经纪人了。

lines.en: : Shitty fucking manager. All you do is stalk me and look at me like I’m some sort of meal or something.
lines.zh: : 烂透了的经纪人。你就会跟踪我，还跟看一盘菜似的看着我。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine you would taste good. You are pretty fucking malnourished, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 我想你吃起来不会好吃。你可是营养不良得厉害，Yumi。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook1
: Yeah, well you’re mal-whatever too, asshole! You would probably taste like fucking...stale bread and foot fungus!
lines.zh: : 哈，你自己也营你妈的养不良啊，混蛋！你大概吃起来就像……发硬的面包加脚气！

lines.en: : You have such a way with words. I suggest repeating that same phrase during your next interview.
lines.zh: : 你还真会说话。我建议你下次面试时把这话复述一遍。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook14
: Hah...are we done here?
lines.zh: : 哈……说完了吗？

lines.en: : Just asking me the shit I wrote down already isn’t exactly helpful.
lines.zh: : 光是把我写下来的东西再问我一遍，算不上什么帮助。

lines.en: : And now that we figured out that thing about the mall, I think it’s safe to say you’re going to be useless for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 而且商场那事既然解决了，我敢说今晚接下来你都没什么用了。

lines.en: : New idea- how about we stop doing job stuff all together and talk about something else?
lines.zh: : 新想法——我们干脆别聊工作的事了，聊点别的怎么样？

lines.en: : The last time we did that, you sat there and watched me eat ice cream for ten minutes.
lines.zh: : 上次我们这么干的时候，你坐在那儿看我吃了十分钟冰淇淋。

lines.en: : Can’t say I’m excited to live through that level of trauma again.
lines.zh: : 我可不想再经历一次那种精神创伤。

lines.en: : Thankfully, there’s no ice cream around.
lines.zh: : 幸好这附近没有冰淇淋。

lines.en: : But if you wanted to maybe close your eyes and drink from one of those water bottles-
lines.zh: : 不过你要是愿意闭上眼睛，就着那些水瓶喝一口——

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook1
: Stop with this weird fucking fetish of watching me eat and drink stuff! It doesn’t make any sense!
lines.zh: : 别再搞你那套看我吃喝的变态癖好了！根本说不通！

lines.en: : Then stop trying to push me away and actually talk to me for a little while.
lines.zh: : 那你就别总想把我推开，认真地跟我聊一会儿。

lines.en: : If you’re not going to be serious, neither am I.
lines.zh: : 你要是不认真，那我也不认真。

lines.en: : But if you can hold a conversation without jumping down my throat, maybe we can actually get somewhere?
lines.zh: : 但要是你能好好说话别一开口就咬人，说不定我们真能有点进展？

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook15
: I want to believe you, but you kind of just fucking waltzed in here even though I told you not to.
lines.zh: : 我想信你，可你他妈就是这么大摇大摆闯进来了，我明明说了别进来。

lines.en: : Why the fuck should I humor you if you won’t even be chill enough to respect a wish as simple as “don’t open the door.”
lines.zh: : 你连「别开门」这么简单的要求都不肯尊重，我凭什么要配合你？

lines.en: : Because, at this rate, you will literally never open the door for me. Or anyone, really.
lines.zh: : 因为照这样下去，你真的永远不会给我开门。换谁都一样。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？

lines.en: : And that’s unhealthy.
lines.zh: : 那样不健康。

lines.en: : Let me sit down.
lines.zh: : 让我坐下吧。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook16
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re fucking creepy.
lines.zh: : 因为你他妈很恶心。

lines.en: : I’ll talk to you “seriously” for a few minutes, but I’m not letting you sit on my fucking bed when I know you can {i}snap{/i} at any moment.
lines.zh: : 我可以「认真」跟你谈几分钟，但我知道你随时可能{i}发作{/i}，所以别想坐我的床。

lines.en: : That’s fair. Fine.
lines.zh: : 说得也对。行吧。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook17
: Cool.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : So...what’s this “serious” stuff you needed to come to my fucking room to talk about?
lines.zh: : 那么……你非得闯进我的房间来谈的「正事」到底是什么？

lines.en: : Well, to start-
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先——

lines.en: : I had dinner with your mom the other day.
lines.zh: : 前几天我跟你妈吃了顿饭。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook18
: You...fucking...{i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……他妈的……{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : I ran into her at the bathhouse recently, got her phone number, and had dinner with her.
lines.zh: : 我前阵子在澡堂碰见她，要了她的电话，然后一起吃了顿饭。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook19
: You barged in...to {i}my{/i} fucking room...to talk about going on a date with my fucking {i}mother?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你闯进……{i}我的{/i}房间……就为了跟我说你和我{i}妈{/i}约会去了？

lines.en: : Is this a joke? Or are you just really fucking bad at explaining things?
lines.zh: : 这是在开玩笑？还是你的表达能力真的烂到这种地步？

lines.en: : Probably the latter.
lines.zh: : 大概是后者。

lines.en: : It wasn’t a date. She was very adamant about that.
lines.zh: : 不是约会。她很坚持这一点。

lines.en: : Oh boy. What great news. Thank you so much for fucking telling me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。真是天大的好消息。谢谢你他妈告诉我。

lines.en: : Go on. I want to hear the rest.
lines.zh: : 继续说。剩下的我也想听。

lines.en: : Did you have fun?
lines.zh: : 你开心吗？

lines.en: : I bet I can guess at least one of the conversation topics.
lines.zh: : 我敢说我至少能猜中一个你们聊的话题。

lines.en: Yeah, I don’t know what I was thinking bringing this up.
lines.zh: 是啊，我真不知道自己提这个干嘛。

lines.en: I should have known from the moment I saw Yuki’s reaction that this wouldn’t go well.
lines.zh: 从我看到 Yuki 反应的那一刻起，我就该知道这会没好结果。

lines.en: But hey, sometimes you have to-
lines.zh: 不过嘛，有些事你总得——

I teleport back in time to a moment of great importance.
lines.zh: 我穿越回了一个极为重要的瞬间。

lines.en: It’s hotter than I’ve grown used to over the last few months.
lines.zh: 比起这几个月我已经习惯的温度，这里热得多。

lines.en: The sun reflects off of the girl in front of me and I can see beads of sweat dripping down her arms.
lines.zh: 阳光从我面前的女孩身上反射回来，我看见汗珠顺着她的手臂往下淌。

lines.en: She’s probably walked for a long time today.
lines.zh: 她今天大概走了很久的路。

lines.en: scene yumi6fun
The sun is stronger than I imagined it was.
lines.zh: 太阳比我想象的更烈。

lines.en: It melts her eyes and turns them into a variety of colors that drip down her shirt before being absorbed into the fabric.
lines.zh: 它融化了她的眼睛，把它们变成五颜六色的液体，顺着她的衬衫往下淌，最后被布料吸收。

lines.en: Off in the distance, I can hear the sound of a chainsaw or thunderstorm or tornado or something equally as loud.
lines.zh: 远处传来电锯、雷暴、龙卷风，或者别的同样震耳的声响。

lines.en: It’s a rumbling noise. One that makes {i}my{/i} skin crawl and {i}her{/i} skin slide off of her bones.
lines.zh: 那是种轰隆隆的声音。一种让{i}我{/i}头皮发麻、让{i}她{/i}的皮肉从骨头上滑落的声音。

lines.en: I pick it up and wear it.
lines.zh: 我把它捡起来，穿在身上。

lines.en: I create a Yumi costume and walk around the second half of town, telling passersby I’m going to castrate them before returning home and crying myself to sleep.
lines.zh: 我做了一套 Yumi 戏服，穿着它在镇子的另一半转悠，告诉每个路人我要阉了他们，然后回家哭着入睡。

lines.en: I miss my mom.
lines.zh: 我想我妈。

lines.en: I just want someone to love me.
lines.zh: 我只是想要有人爱我。

: TELL ME YOU FUCKING SEE ME!
lines.zh: : 你他妈给我说你看得见我！

lines.en: : ...What?
: Stop conveniently going into a fucking mind-coma or whatever it is you’re doing while you’re around me!
lines.zh: : 别再趁机陷入你那该死的「精神昏迷」还是什么玩意儿了，在我面前别这样！

lines.en: : It creeps me the fuck out and I wasn’t finished yelling at you yet!
lines.zh: : 这让我起一身鸡皮疙瘩，而且我还没骂完呢！

lines.en: : Why were you with my mom?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么和我妈在一起？！

lines.en: : She wanted to talk to me about something.
lines.zh: : 她想跟我谈点事。

lines.en: : What?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！

lines.en: : What did she want to talk about?!
lines.zh: : 她想谈什么？！

lines.en: : You.
: She wanted to see how you were doing.
lines.zh: : 她想了解你过得怎么样。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook21

lines.zh: : ……为什么？

lines.en: : Because you’re her daughter.
lines.zh: : 因为你是她女儿。

lines.en: : Since fucking when?
lines.zh: : 从他妈什么时候开始的？

lines.en: : Since she’s been sober.
lines.zh: : 从她戒了酒开始。

lines.en: : You think I haven’t heard that before?
lines.zh: : 你以为我没听过这话？

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’ve heard before.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你以前听过什么。

lines.en: : I just talked to someone that wanted to talk to me.
lines.zh: : 我只是跟一个想跟我说话的人说了话。

lines.en: : And I thought it might be good if you talked to her as well.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得，如果你也跟她聊聊，可能会好些。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook22
: Awe, you did all that just for me? How sweet of you!
lines.zh: : 哇哦，你做这些全是为了我？真贴心啊！

lines.en: : What’s next, Sensei? Gonna buy me a car? Start paying for my phone bill?
lines.zh: : 接下来呢，老师？要给我买车吗？要替我交话费吗？

lines.en: : Are you still trying to make up for mouth-[raping] me?
lines.zh: : 你还在为口[raping]我的事赎罪吗？

lines.en: : You know you could do it again right now and nothing would even happen, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你现在再来一次也什么都不会发生，对吧？

lines.en: : Everyone already heard me screaming at you earlier and no one showed up at all.
lines.zh: : 刚才所有人听见我冲你喊了，可一个都没来。

lines.en: : Why do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这是为什么？

lines.en: : Are these walls too thick to hear through?
lines.zh: : 是这些墙厚到听不见吗？

lines.en: : Or do you think that maybe, just {i}maybe{/i}, some of them want me to get hurt?
lines.zh: : 还是说你觉得，也许，只是{i}也许{/i}，有些人就想看我受伤？

lines.en: : Maybe they want to hear me scream?
lines.zh: : 也许他们就想听我尖叫？

lines.en: : Want to find out, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 想不想弄清楚啊，老师？

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t be holding onto my shirt right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在大概不该揪着我的衬衫。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook23
: You probably shouldn’t have turned into a fucking vegetable after dropping a bomb on me!
lines.zh: : 那你大概也不该在扔完炸弹之后变成一坨该死的植物人！

lines.en: : Stay the fuck away from my mom! She has nothing to do with you! She has nothing to do with me either!
lines.zh: : 离我妈远点！她跟你没关系！她跟我也没关系！

lines.en: : I get it. I won’t bring her up again.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。我不会再提她了。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean for you to explode.
lines.zh: : 我不是有意让你炸的。

lines.en: : You don’t drop fucking bombs without expecting them to explode, douchebag.
lines.zh: : 扔炸弹还能指望它不炸吗，蠢货。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook24
: I am the child of a fucking criminal and a drug addict.
lines.zh: : 我是一个罪犯和一个瘾君子生的孩子。

lines.en: : And I am trying...my fucking hardest...to not be like either one of them.
lines.zh: : 而我在拼了……拼了命地努力……不要变成他们中的任何一个。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook25
: So stop trying to get me to open up to you and let me deal with it the same way I deal with everything else!
lines.zh: : 所以别再逼我对你敞开心扉了，让我像处理别的事一样处理它！

lines.en: : You want to “fix” the class delinquent?!
lines.zh: : 你想「改造」班上的不良少女？！

lines.en: : You want me to stop calling you so many names?!
lines.zh: : 你想让我别再骂你？！

lines.en: : Then use your fucking brain for the first time in your life and figure out what it is I need!
lines.zh: : 那就用你这辈子第一次动动脑子，想清楚我到底需要什么！

lines.en: : And, here’s a tip for you.
lines.zh: : 再给你个提示。

lines.en: : It’s sure as hell not my fucking mother.
lines.zh: : 绝对他妈不是我妈。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to offend you.
lines.zh: : 我不是有意冒犯你。

lines.en: : Yeah. You didn’t mean to fucking kiss me either.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你也不是有意他妈亲我的。

lines.en: : Wonder why you keep just “accidentally” doing shit to hurt {i}me{/i} but not anyone else.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪，你为什么总「不小心」做些伤害{i}我{/i}的事，却不去伤害别人。

lines.en: : Are you having fun, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你玩得开心吗，老师？

lines.en: : I’m guessing you got bored of our detentions and now you’re just trying to fuck me up in even worse ways?
lines.zh: : 我猜你是腻了我们那些留堂，现在想用更狠的方式把我搞垮？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, okay? I don’t know what else you want me to say.
lines.zh: : 对不起，行吗？我不知道你还想让我说什么。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook26
: God fucking damnit. Why did you even come in here?
lines.zh: : 操他妈的。你到底为什么要进来？

lines.en: : Nothing good ever happens when you’re around.
lines.zh: : 你在的时候从来没发生过什么好事。

lines.en: : But...my fucking {i}mom{/i}?
lines.zh: : 可是……我他妈的{i}妈{/i}？

lines.en: : I know you don’t like me, but that’s just...too fucking much.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不喜欢我，但这也……太过分了。

lines.en: : Yumi, I-
lines.zh: : Yumi，我——

lines.en: : Just get out. I don’t want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 滚出去。我不想听。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook25
: I TOLD YOU TO GET OUT!
lines.zh: : 我说了让你滚出去！

lines.en: : You’re...still holding onto my collar.
lines.zh: : 你……还揪着我的衣领呢。

lines.en: scene yumidormnotebook27
: Oh. Right. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。是啊。

lines.en: : Sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : Why are {i}you{/i} apologizing when-
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么道歉——

lines.en: : Just get out please.
lines.zh: : 求你了，出去吧。

lines.en: : The only thing I hate more than crying in front of people is how often I have to fucking put up with you now.
lines.zh: : 比在别人面前哭更让我恨的，只有现在我得忍受你的频率。

lines.en: scene black
I do as she says and exit the room, once again confused about how things managed to go haywire at the worst possible moment.
lines.zh: 我照她说的做了，走出房间，又一次搞不懂事情怎么总在最糟糕的时刻失控。

lines.en: Bringing up Yumi’s mom was a mistake.
lines.zh: 提起 Yumi 的妈妈是个错误。

lines.en: I honestly don’t understand why I ever considered it in the first place.
lines.zh: 我真不明白自己当初怎么会想要这么做。

lines.en: And so I find myself in one more situation where she has been hurt by something I have done behind the wheel-
lines.zh: 于是我又一次陷入这样的境地——她被我亲手酿成的事伤到了——

lines.en: And I can’t help but wonder who it is that I will hurt next.
lines.zh: 而我不禁在想，下一个被我伤到的人会是谁。

{i}Yumi’s affection stays exactly the same!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度纹丝未动！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Everything you touch turns to shit!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你碰过的东西都会变成屎！{/i}
